summary.text: Jonathan Pennell is an Air Force veteran and the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 55 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He said in a Ballotpedia survey that he works as a customer service supervisor with Mid-Continent Public Library.

paragraphs.text: Pennell graduated from Truman High School and earned associate degrees from Metropolitan Community College in 2004 and the Community College of the Air Force in 2009, and a bachelor's degree from Park University in 2011, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his U.S. Air Force service as 2005 to 2009.

In a 2026 survey, he said he spent four years in the Air Force maintaining the A-10 Thunderbolt II, then worked in the federal government supervising teams that processed Freedom of Information Act requests.
Pennell said he and his wife, Holly, a public school teacher, are raising three teenagers.

He named strengthening working families, protecting public education, and preserving individual liberty and accountable government as his key messages, and listed education, workforce development, government accountability and veterans as policy interests.
